name: Pydantic Logfire
summary: OpenTelemetry-based observability platform from the Pydantic team for tracing LLM apps and agents, with SQL querying and evals.
description: The `logfire` SDK (MIT) is an opinionated OpenTelemetry wrapper supporting traces, metrics and logs; the hosted platform is queried with SQL. Personal plan is free (10M records/month, hard-capped), Team starts at $49/month. An MCP server is available at https://github.com/pydantic/logfire-mcp.

agent_access.notes: The llms.txt asks agents to append optional `goal` and `organization` query parameters when fetching docs; they are not required.
